text: Lights on, sky clear. Soup's on too, hon. Ninety percent bolts, ten percent love.
And there's light! Whole Row lit up like a recall notice. Here's your 110. Now sit down, the pair of you — you're too thin.
The Row runs on one generator and three fuses. Repo drones lifted the fuses last night, then dropped 'em all over the yard when the Mutts spooked 'em. Bring my lights back, hon.
110 bolts. And then you'll eat something. That part ain't optional.
Still dark, hon. The little ones have started telling ghost stories about the billing department.
Quietest dusk in years. Take your 90. Your daddy'd be proud — he threw a wrench at one once. Missed. But the SPIRIT was there.
Every dusk the Vulture Drones circle the Row, pricing our roofs for the next repossession. Three fewer appraisers would do wonders for property values.
Everything's an asset if you squint, hon. 90 bolts. Aim for the clipboard.
Still hear 'em up there, muttering square footage. Keep swinging.
Well, if it isn't the Bolt boy. Heard they took your garage. Welcome to the club, hon — dues are zero and the roof leaks.
That's what your father said. Difference is, you brought a mallet and a robot with a mouth on him. I like your odds better.
